title: Short Encoding of Words
description: Calculate the length of the shortest reference string s that encodes words by removing suffixes.
pseudocode:
1. Convert words to a set for O(1) lookups.
2. For each word in the original list:
3. Remove all suffixes of the word from the set.
4. Calculate the sum of (length of each remaining word + 1).

steps.note: Initialize a set with unique words: {'time', 'me', 'bell'}.
Processing 'time': check if any suffixes exist. 'ime', 'me', 'e' are suffixes.
Removing 'me' from the set since it is a suffix of 'time'.
Processing 'bell': no suffixes found in the set.
